items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: It happened to be one of Dinah Washington's LPs that we came and made.

ctx.x: the piano and Jimmy Crawford on drums. Now, I don't know who was on bass. Maybe Pemberton or somebody. I don't recall. Or Jack -- bass player that played with Goodman's band, good bass player, and just what Quincy Jones said about he hired Jimmy Crawford and Milt Hinton to make a record date with him, not to play in a band. He didn't have a band then. That was before he went to Hollywood.
It happened to be one of Dinah Washington's LPs that we came and made. He said that was the greatest album that he's ever made. That's what Quincy said.
Oh, yeah, right, this (inaudible), yes. Oh, yeah, I have this in a book in fact.
